title: El Mapa Manchado
summary: Tico derrama jugo de baya sobre su nuevo mapa y, por vergüenza, finge saber el camino. Al perderse, aprende que es mejor admitir los errores y pedir ayuda.
moral: Todos cometemos errores; lo importante es ser honestos y no tener miedo de pedir ayuda.
ambient_audio_prompt: Cheerful orchestral magical forest background music, acoustic guitar and gentle flutes, transitions to slightly mysterious marimba in the middle, ends with triumphant and warm magical chimes

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Bright morning magical forest setting. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, wearing a small green adventurer's backpack with acorns and a tiny compass. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions. Vibrant green leaves in the blurred background.
scenes.audio_text: ¡Hola, amigos! Soy Tico, vuestro explorador favorito. ¡Qué alegría veros en el Bosque Mágico!

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, wearing a small green adventurer's backpack with acorns and a tiny compass. He is proudly holding out a pristine rolled-up paper map. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: ¡Mirad lo que tengo aquí! Es el mapa para llegar a la Cascada de Cristal. ¡Hoy voy a ir yo solito!

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, wearing a green backpack, sitting on a log. He is holding a juicy purple berry in one paw and the open map in the other. A big purple drop falls from the berry right onto the map. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Mmm, voy a comer unas bayas moradas antes de salir. Están muy ricas, pero... ¡Uy! ¡Oh, no!

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is looking absolutely terrified at a large, wet purple stain right in the center of the paper map. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: ¡Se ha caído una gota gigante! ¡He manchado el mapa justo donde estaba el camino secreto!

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He looks nervously straight into the camera, holding the stained map. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Amigos... ¿creéis que debería pedir ayuda a alguien, o intentar ir yo solo para que nadie se ría de mi error?

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is walking confidently but sweating a little, holding the stained map up. Walking through dense green trees. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Yo pensé: '¡Soy un explorador valiente! No le diré a nadie que lo he estropeado, adivinaré el camino'.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. The environment is now a darker, purplish forest with twisted branches. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He looks confused and scratches his head. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Pero como no veía la ruta, me metí en el Bosque de los Susurros... ¡y me perdí por completo! ¡Qué oscuro estaba!

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is looking up at a large, wise brown owl perched on a low branch. Tico tries to puff his chest and look brave. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Entonces bajó volando el sabio señor Búho. Me vio dar vueltas y me preguntó si necesitaba ayuda.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He quickly hides the stained map behind his back, smiling awkwardly. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Yo escondí el mapa detrás de mí y le mentí. Le dije: '¡Oh, no, no! Sé perfectamente por dónde voy'.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. A spooky shadow shaped like a monster appears on a tree behind Tico. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He shivers, looks at the shadow, and drops his shoulders in defeat. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Pero vi una sombra gigante y me temblaron las patitas. Me di cuenta de que fingir no servía de nada.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He slowly holds out the stained map to the owl, looking down with a sad, sorry expression. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Así que cerré los ojos y le enseñé la mancha gigante. Le dije la verdad: '¡Me he equivocado y estoy muy perdido!'

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is looking happily up as the friendly brown owl points with his wing towards a brightly lit path. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: ¿Y sabéis qué pasó? ¡El señor Búho no se enfadó! Me sonrió y me dijo que todo el mundo comete errores.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is walking joyfully alongside the flying brown owl out of the dark woods toward warm sunlight. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Con sus grandes ojos de búho, pudo leer las pistas en las esquinas del mapa y me guio hacia la luz.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Medium shot. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He stands in awe in front of a majestic, glowing crystal waterfall shimmering in rainbow colors. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: ¡Por fin llegamos a la Cascada de Cristal! ¡Mirad qué colores! Si no llego a pedir ayuda, nunca la habría visto.

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He looks directly at the camera with a warm, caring smile. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: Vosotros, cuando cometáis un error sin querer o rompáis algo... ¿qué es lo mejor que podéis hacer?

scenes.visual_prompt: 3D Disney Pixar style. Close-up. Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, green backpack. He is waving happily at the camera with a glowing magical waterfall behind him. Character is talking, mouth moving, animated facial expressions.
scenes.audio_text: ¡Exacto! Decir la verdad y pedir ayuda, ¡siempre hay alguien dispuesto a darnos una pata! ¡Hasta la próxima aventura!
